{{SupportPage|vendor=D-Link|model=DWL-520}} Mini PCI card on a Mini PCI -> PCI adapter
15 dBm rated output power [http://djbnetbsd.drivehq.com/PC/NetBSD/PRISM/models.html On djb's PRISM models page] ([http://wikidevi.wi-cat.ru/files/archive/djnetbsd_old/PRISM%20Models.html archived here]) There are two FCC IDs which may have been used for this model and additional sub-revisions - KA22002060010-1 and KA22002060010-2. :"8WPCG01..3A1" and a checkbox for "WPC-G01" and "WPC-B13" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos for KA22002060010-1. :"8WPCB13..0B1" (alt. name WPC-B13) is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos for the board with FCC ID KA22002060010-2.
